title: introduce-credential-mediator-and-multiprotocol-stream-gateway
author: Sofia Martinez
description:
Motivation: multiple SDKs (Go/TS/Python) needed a lightweight, reproducible bridge to support evolving token/credential topologies and two simultaneous streaming protocols used in the field (HTTP/1.1 chunked streaming + gRPC bidi). This PR implements a credential mediator component in the Go SDK and a multiprotocol stream gateway that lets the Go SDK accept or translate both streaming modes, enabling parity with TS/Python ergonomics without changing upstream server contracts.

What this changes: introduces a CredentialMediator type that centralizes token refresh, singleflight acquisition, and lease tracking. Adds an abstract StreamGateway interface plus two concrete adapters: ChunkedGateway (HTTP/1.1 chunked framing) and GRPCGateway (bidi gRPC adapter). A small compatibility shim (MultiplexShim) is provided to negotiate preferred protocol at handshake time so applications using older Go SDK pumps continue to operate while newer clients can opt into gRPC.

Design highlights: CredentialMediator offers: (1) pluggable credential providers (env/KMS/opaque-chain), (2) lease-aware prefetching to avoid 401s during long-running streams, and (3) a compact metrics surface (cred.acquisition.latency, cred.prefetch.count, cred.lease.expiry). StreamGateway includes backpressure-friendly buffering and exposes a minimal iterator-style API modeled after existing SDK idioms; the GRPC adapter preserves chunk boundaries and supports resumable offsets. The MultiplexShim performs a short negotiation exchange (client-supported-protos header) and falls back to chunked streaming if negotiation fails.

Testing & rollout: unit tests added for mediator behavior, prefetch race conditions, and gateway translations. Integration tests run against a local pairing service that simulates token rotation and both streaming endpoints. A canary rollout was performed on Dedicated test cluster 3 (redwood-dedicated-canary-3) for 48h with circuit-breaker thresholds in place. Observability: exposed new metrics and logs; added an opt-in debug env var to dump handshake traces.

Backward compatibility: default behavior is unchanged for existing users. The new mediator is enabled by default for long-lived stream clients (configurable via ClientConfig.Streaming.CredentialMode). The multiprotocol gateway is opt-in via ClientConfig.Streaming.Protocols = ["auto", "chunked", "grpc"]. No server-side changes are required.

Why unique: this PR focuses on building an SDK-side composable bridge (mediator+gateway) rather than changing server contracts, reducing cross-team coordination required to land multi-SDK parity improvements and making the Go SDK more ergonomic for long-lived workloads.
commits: init: add credential mediator core types and interfaces
feat(stream): implement chunked and grpc gateway adapters
feat(compat): add multiplexing handshake shim and protocol negotiation
test: add unit tests for mediator prefetch and lease expiry races
ci: add integration job to run local pairing service against gateways
docs: document migration knobs and observability metrics
chore: bump go-sdk version to v1.6.0-rc.1
review_comments: Daniel Cho: the singleflight acquisition looks good; can we add a defensive timeout for provider calls to avoid blocking goroutines during network partitions?
Sofia Martinez: added context timeouts to credential provider calls and added a unit test that simulates a slow provider returning after the timeout.
Priya Nair: please ensure metric labels follow existing conventions (snake_case vs camelCase). Also confirm cardinality control for provider_id label.
Sofia Martinez: normalized metric labels to snake_case and removed provider_id label, replaced with provider_kind with low cardinality. Updated metrics_registry.go accordingly.
Evan Brooks: integration tests flaked once due to connection reset in the pairing server; recommend adding a retry/poll in the canary job and mark the test as flaky-aware.
Sofia Martinez: added retry with backoff to integration harness and documented the flakiness in the test comment. Reran CI; green.
release_notes: Add CredentialMediator + StreamGateway adapters to Go SDK; multiprotocol streaming (chunked + gRPC) enabled via opt-in config. Metrics: cred.acquisition.latency, cred.prefetch.count, cred.lease.expiry. Bumped go-sdk preliminary release to v1.6.0-rc.1.
tests: unit: mediator tests cover singleflight, prefetch, lease expiry (100% pass)
integration: pairing-service scenario (token rotation + stream migration) (stable after retry fix)
e2e-canary: Dedicated cluster 3 48h canary with max-allowed-401-rate=0.1% (passed)
compatibility_matrix: Go SDK v1.6.x -> supports auto multiplexing with TS/Python clients that advertise grpc in handshake
TS SDK: no server change required; TS client can opt-in to grpc and use the same mediator concepts (separate PRs in TS/Python repos will follow)
Python SDK: unchanged behavior; Python will gain parity via upcoming PR that implements CredentialProvider hooks and handshake flags
Server: no contract change; handshake is optional client-side negotiation header only
